contributors.role_summary: Problem framing · Source curation · Review direction
contributors.description: Originated the problem, defined the Monitor's evidentiary boundaries, selected and challenged sources, and directs acceptance decisions. Automated systems and AI-assisted implementation are identified separately.
Checks approved provider pages for model-listing changes. It does not test behavior and cannot create a PASS or FAIL.
Searches separated public-source channels for leads. A match remains an untrusted review candidate and never becomes accepted evidence automatically.

contributors.role_summary: Recalculate whether accepted evidence remains usable
contributors.description: Applies the published age and lifecycle policy to existing evidence. It never reruns a behavioral probe or rewrites the dated result.
Runs a bounded, predeclared reproduction and preserves the receipt. Its output still requires human review before it can support a public observation.
